generations.conceptPrompt: A 1989 post parcel from the Everon post office: a flat rectangular packet wrapped in brown paper and tied with string, with a blank address label on top. Plain brown kraft paper, crisp folded corners, string tied round both ways with a knot on top, a blank white label on the top face. Single object, orthographic-style three-quarter product shot from slightly above, the whole object in frame, plain flat light grey background, soft even studio light, no hands, no stand, no text, no logos, no watermark.
